description: Paint tree edges and sum painted-edge counts over an operation trace of arbitrary path queries.

source.title: Tree painting
source.discovery_scope: High-level Euler-tour and directional-sum algorithm description only; no source code or prose copied.

input.paint_operation: opcode=0 paints edge a; b must be 0; repeated painting is idempotent
input.edge_range: Undirected edges in input order define stable edge IDs and form one simple tree.

output.meaning: Sum of the painted-edge counts returned by all path-query operations in trace order.

algorithm_details.primary: Root the tree and record each DFS-tour edge traversal in one of two directional segment trees. A paint sets both occurrences; an ancestor-path query subtracts reverse-direction sums from forward-direction sums, and an arbitrary path splits at its LCA.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: For each query, BFS the current tree to recover its unique path and count painted edge IDs directly.
algorithm_details.primary_complexity: O(N^2 + (N+Q) log N) time and O(N) auxiliary space in the bounded edge-scan implementation.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle_complexity: O(Q*N) time and O(N+Q) auxiliary space.
